title: US ground stop delays flights from Incheon Airport
caption:
A rare nationwide ground stop in the US caused delays for international flights departing from South Korea. The FAA reports the issue originated from a widespread communications failure.

Source: Koreaherald - US ground stop delays flights from Incheon Airport
